errors.evidence: Description states 83.8% and 83.9% for parameter amounts 22 and 25 respectively, but the figure shows approximately 83.7% for 22 and 83.5% for 25.
The description does not mention the title or the overall goal of the chart, which relates to the evaluation of the MITF method's performance.
The description does not specify the y-axis values and intervals accurately as showing 17, 19, 22, 25; and does not clarify the percentage as the y-axis unit.
